description: This Java class handles JSON deserialization and validation for provisioning category definitions in the Fineract platform. It validates JSON input for creating or updating provisioning categories, ensuring required fields are present and conform to constraints.

classes.name: ProvisioningCategoryDefinitionJsonDeserializer
classes.description: A component class responsible for deserializing and validating JSON data related to provisioning category definitions, specifically for create and update operations.

methods.name: validateForCreate
methods.description: Validates JSON input for creating a provisioning category. Checks for blank input, unsupported parameters, and validates the 'categoryname' field for presence and length constraints.

methods.name: validateForUpdate
methods.description: Validates JSON input for updating a provisioning category. Checks for blank input, unsupported parameters, and conditionally validates the 'categoryname' field if it exists.
